title: Cybersecurity experts point out a technical inconsistency in the apocalyptic predictions of certain AI leaders regarding hacking
content_md:
Cybersecurity experts point out a technical inconsistency in the apocalyptic predictions of certain AI leaders regarding hacking. The analysis questions whether AI capabilities are being overstated in security threat assessments.

via Mastodon https://www.techmeme.com/260915/p59
exclude_reason: French-language opinion piece on AI and hacking predictions. Editorial, not a security event.
